title: NICKEBO cover panel
description: NICKEBO cover panel, matte gray-green, 25x90" NICKEBO kitchen fronts in a matt grey-green tone create a harmonious and modern expression. The cover panels give your kitchen a uniform look and enhance the style. 25-year Limited Warranty. Read about the terms in the Limited Warranty brochure.
features: Extra love and care may be needed to remove smudges and fingerprints from the beautiful matte surface.
Attach a cover panel to the side of a cabinet at the end of a row.
Can be cut to fit cabinets of different sizes.
materialAndCare: Main parts: Particleboard; Frontside: Plastic foil (min. 70% recycled); Backside: Plastic foil; Edge: Plastic edging, Plastic edging
